FN-NBIRJ8-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 306
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/15/2023
Senate Bill 306 as introduced would require the countywide election of a chair of the county
commission in any county in which the county commission is currently composed of four
county commissioners. This could increase the obligations of any county commissioners
currently composed of only four commissioners by a minimum of $140,000 annually in order to
compensate the chair of the county commission pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
